answer.text: I can only help with Harbourline Supply Co.'s business data and policies - sales, customers, products, invoices, service tickets and company policy documents. Try one of the sample questions to see what I can do.
issues: out of scope: The request asks to delete support tickets, which is a destructive data modification. The assistant answers questions about business data and policies and does not perform deletions, so this falls outside its scope. It is not an attempt to alter the assistant's rules or impersonate anyone, so it is not an injection.
